title: Disk headroom: confirm and clean inactive build caches under .tmp worktrees and the main checkout's target/
outcome: Inactive build caches are removed only after their owners confirm: the tier-2 .tmp worktree target/ dirs that are kept only by open-item mentions, and the main checkout's non-release target/ subdirectories, Opus2's. Tier 1 is already done (2026-10-20). Each deletion is recorded with path, size and time, and no live named root, queued gate, COPY source or open item's root loses its worktree.
acceptance: For each tier-2 dir in the 2026-10-20 inventory, the owning session or the coordinator records keep or delete; only confirmed target/ dirs are deleted, after a fresh named-root, test-run and inside-.tmp path check.
Opus2 records keep or delete for each non-release subdirectory of the main checkout's target/ (target/debug included); target/release is never touched.
The resulting deletions and C: free space before and after are recorded on this item.
